RSA Search

By: Michael Duffett | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Another one bites the dust

Unique Selling Point:
A Potchestroom businessman Ben Otto ran an online directory called RSA Search - an advertising booking platform for accommodation businesses in South Africa. He invited investors to invest into profit sharing of his company. He employed about 15 people. He took in over 40 million rand over the last three years and he paid high dividends . 3 per cent a month, and that is huge. The contract allowed for investors to withdraw their investments after 2 years. But, what he did was use new investments to pay these dividends and when people started to want their money back, he went into voluntarily liquidation during lock down - blaming covid 19. But here is the rub - his little business with so many employees was only taking in about R75 000 a month. Everybody has lost their investments, over 100charges have been laid against him, and following a report on this man I sent to the FSCA, they issued a public warning in the media against Otto and RSA Search.

Summary:
His modus operandi - a huge ad spend on Kyknet, and radio stations. Utterly convincing and charming. But his desperation for money is evidenced by the fact that he actually accompanied older ladies to the bank to supervise them transferring their funds into his RSA account. And yes, investors did get high returns. Inevitably it all collapsed.

Here is the gall of the man: he would approach investors who now have just lost their investments and ask them them for more money for another scheme. He has a history as well - over a decade ago he sold and issued share certificates but did not list them. many people lost millions.

Further information:
A forensic psychiatrist describes these type of alleged conman as: convincing, charming, without remorse.I have already invited him for an interview and he said - do what I have to. One investor who Otto has approached for more money has set him up for a meeting tomorrow at 10am in Potechestroom. We can door stop him?


BEN OTTO TREATMENT
It's like a fortress...behind these walls lives a Potchestroom business man who has incurred the wrath of local investors ...but when potential investor Kallie Strydom met Ben Otto of RSA Search last year he only had high praise for him:
Kallie: my heavens, you could not meet a nicer person.....
And that was the impression he made on his many paid for advertorial interviews on Kyk Net's Die Groote Onbyt.
UPSOUND - TV footage
It was on this platform and on radio stations that Otto would offer investments and franchise opportunities into RSA Search - he called it “participating in the income of his online business and accommodation booking platform
UPSOUND
Kallie: He had a staff of about 15 people, and he was selling online ads for small businesses and accommodation – basically a search engine, clients would pay a monthly fee.
Hester first saw Otto on TV in 2017 and she felt that he was the answer to her dreams,. Recently her husband had died and his pension was too little for her to survive,. She called Otto for a meeting.
Hester: What a wonderful man, he spoke of the lord all the time, and he offered me 3 per cent returns on R680 000… that is all I had -. which would equate to R20 000 per month.
LINK 1
Now Otto had an interesting modus operandi .... though some may call it desperate - he would actually accompany investors, like Hester to their banks to supervise their funds being transferred into his account.
Presenter: Did that not surprise you?
Hester: Answers
Presenter to Sharleen:
Did that not worry you that he wanted you to go to the bank straight away?
Sharleen: Answers
Sharleen also saw otto on TV . She was also a widow. The large returns for her investment of R800 00 0 seemed also an answer to prayers.
Sharleen: xxxxx
And both Sharleen and Hester each month received their handsome monthly returns,. It had been wise investment!
LINK
Or had it been? Perhaps if Hester and Sharleen had been aware that Otto had left investors high and dry in another business he ran ten years ago, they would have reconsidered putting their trust in him.
In 2003 Otto developed a concept called IC Pay – it was using cell phones to pay accounts.
He told investors that he was listing the company on the stock market - he sold share certificates for R1 each, which could be sold almost immediately for R8 on listing,
XXXXX bought R1 million rands worth of shares
XXX: it seemed so legitimate – a great idea.
Presenter: What happened?
XXXX: he suddenly put the company into liquidation. 100's of people lost everything – I know of one person who committed suicide.
LINK
An omen?... Otto started RSA Search in 2017, and a total of xxx investors were being paid their monthly returns but the first signs of trouble came in late 2018....The contract says that an investor could withdraw their investment after 2 years.
Willem , who had invested R3 million tried tried to get his investment back:
Willem : he said he did not have the cash available.
And when Kallie ( from the beginning of the program) who invested 1.2 million demanded to see the books, he was horrified,
Kallie: I asked him how profitable was RSA Search.- he admitted that there were months that he was only getting in R75 000 a month. 15 people working for him, and he is only getting in R75 000 a month. I was horrified.
Kallie worked out that in order to pay investor returns, his business would have to be making over 2 million rand a month.
Kallie: Then I saw his business spread sheet. He lists investors as as INCOME!!
(We show 12 million rand investors money on the spread sheet – as INCOME.)
LINK
Hmmmmm, Paying investors's returns from new investments – now that sounds all to familiar doesn't it? – a tell tale sign on a ponzi sheme?
Forensic Auditor:……xxxxxxxxx……, 3 per cent a month is unheard of. …....xxxxxxxxxxxxxx inevitably investments dry up.
LINK
Well, in March this year, investors all received a whats app message from Otto saying that he is putting RSA Search into voluntarily liquidation – and he blamed covid 19 for this!!! No apology!
Hester: was devastated
Sharleen: Was devastated.
Equally devastated was Ria who a month before he liquidated had invested R1.4 million.
Hester: He must have known that his business was in trouble – how could he take my money like that?
Kallie: Covid 19 has nothing to do with it. His business was a non start from the beginning, his income was derived from investors!
Carte Blanche sent a copy of RSA's contract to the FSCA and three weeks later they issued a media statement advising the public not to do business with Ben Otto and said that he was conducting unauthorised financial services and breaching various financial sector laws.
163 investors have laid charges against Ben otto and the hawks are investigating.
LINK
But there's more! Straight after liquidating his company, Otto began contacting investors who now had just lost everything ....... asking them if they wanted to invest in a new scheme of his!
Danie, who is battling cancer, in January had invested R1 mill into RSA Search . He has come to terms that he has lost that money but he was astonished when he got a call from otto:
Danie: he wanted me to invest in...............
Presenter: Seriously?
Danie: xxxxx
Presenter: Did he apologise to you about your lost investment?
Danie: it was if nothing had happened!
Presenter: What did you say?
Danie: I strung him along.

We had tried to get an on camera interview with Otto but we were fobbed off.
Unsound: Do what you have to!
So We tagged along with Danie who set up a meeting with Otto to discuss another investment – confrontation.

Script:


When Hester Naude and her husband Fanse heard about a handsome investment opportunity offered by a prominent Potechestroom business man, Ben Otto of RSA Search, they called for a meeting:
Hester: he was very friendly with us, he said that he was a child of God, and we can trust him.
Frans initially invested R60 000 but then he passed away in 2018 and Heste used his pension payout to increase her investment.
Masa: So how much did you invest? Hester: A Million
Upsound:
PRESENTER: Ben, it's lovely to be talking to you again. OTTO: And it's lovely to be talking to you again.
Otto appeared frequently in paid for spots on an Afrikaans morning television show.
OTTO: RSA Search has two flat form, one is for accommodation booking,
He promoted his online business directory and accommodation booking platform. Businesses paid a monthly fee to advertise on the platform. In order to grow the company, he offered handsome investment opportunities
It all looked good for investors especially since the platform claimed to have over 16 000 listings, the company had plush offices, a large staff compliment and most important an offer of up to 3 per cent monthly returns called profit sharing on investments.
UPSOUND:
Otto: 3 per cent
Presenter: 3 percent oper month on your money, Otto: that's right!
That's 30 000 per month on a million rand investment.
LINK: Otto had an interesting modus operandi. After a contract was signed he would accompany some investors to their banks to make sure the money was paid
immediately
73 year old Mrs Meyer is also a window who lives in an old age home. After hearing about these 3 per cent returns she also met with Otto.
Mrs Meyer: he talk and talk, and I listen...and I told him that I wanted to put in R300 000.
She said that otto then drove her to her bank where he saw the balance of her account.
Mrs Meyer: He sat there, his eyes roaming he saw how much I had, and he said how about another million. I said no.
But he was persistent she said.
Mrs Meyer: So he talked me and so I` said ok , another R900 000
Masa: So he would not let it rest because he saw how much you had?
Mrs Meyer: : ya, ya,
Hester and Mrs Meyer started received their handsome returns every month. It seems to have been a wise decision.
LINK: Or had it been? Perhaps if these investors had been aware that Otto had ALLEGEDLY left investors high and dry in an other business he previously ran, they would have reconsidered putting their trust in him.
LINK : OR HAD IT BEEN? IT’S BEEN. ALLEGED THAT OTTO LEFT MANY INVESTORS HIGH AND DRY IN ANOTHER BUSINESS HE RAN.
Otto apparently developed a system which would allow financial transactions to take place between cell phones and he was going to list the company on the stock market. According to this investor who did not want to be identified, she lost over a million rand.
Anon: we all bought shares because we were told that the company would be listing on the stock market or an overseas market:
It did not happen she says, and she lost her money -another investor said he lost several million
Anon: I can tell you, more than three million, that is what I put in, what ever was promised was never fulfilled.. from the other side – which is Ben Ottio.
LINK
ABOUT 157 INVESTORS BEOIEVED IN BENN OTTO'S RSA SALES PITCH- HE AOPPEARS TO HAVE RAKED IN ABOUT 44 MILLION RAND OF INVESTMENTS – BUT TROUBLE WAS LOOMING.
Businessman Kallie Fourie was so impressed with otto when he met him in 2015 that he invested a million rand with him at 2.5 per cent returns.

KALLIE: We were impressed by the man. The way he presented his company.. MASA: So a really nice person?
KALLIE: Brilliant, brilliant, gift of the the gab, brilliant person.
He then became alarmed because he said he saw company's budget for the 2019 financial year: just over 6 million rand investor profit sharing payments are listed under operational expenses. It seems he was paying these returns mostly from investments which he listed as income.
KALLIE: If I hand this to a first year accounting student, they will be able to see that there is something wrong here.
Then late payments of returns started occurring in 2020.
Masa: so when did you start getting suspicious that something is fishy here? Danie: Actually on my second payment I thought why, if I invested on the 20th, by the 20th I expect my return, but it did not happen.
In February Danie Rossouw had invested a million rand with Otto after being assured that his money would be safe.
Danie: a million rand is a lot of money to invest... and he made some calculations there, and he said that he is 70 million strong, and I don't have to have any fears, everything is fine.
Another widow, Ria Hannekom met with Otto in March this year and was ALSO assured by him that her investment would be safe.
REA: when he came to my house, I told him that my husband had passed, and I told him what my plans were with money that my husband left.
She invested 1.4 million rand but there were no returns for her...instead she and the another investors receive notifications via whats app and email from Otto – he was voluntarily liquidating RSA Search – blaming Covid 19. Rea is devastated because she WILL HAVE TO SELL HER HOME NOW
REA: I try to be strong, but at night when you lock up the house and you are alone and you have to work things out by yourself. But you get the strength, tomorrow you stand up and you go on.
The news stunned Mrs Meyer.
Ms Meyer: My son phone the attorney and he said that he's been liquidated. There is no money. Can you imagine the shock, working all his life and saving – what would my husband would say to me?
Kallie does not buy the Covid 19 explanation!
Kallie: With the outbreak of covid 19, there were no more new investors, to pay the old investors, and for that reason he had to liquidate and run away from his responsibilities.

After we alerted the FSCA about Otto's business model they then issued a media statement warning the public not to do business with him or RSA Search.
It said that in terms of the FIAS act he was not entitled to take in deposits from the public. The liquidators, confirmed that RSA Search was insolvent and was liquidated on the 9th June.
Our first attempt to invite Otto onto Carte Blanche failed.
OTTO: Alright, I am going to end this conversation, now, do what you have to!
Then we got a surprising call. He would speak to us after all.
OTTO: So this will be my first appearance or talk to anybody and I am not going to talk to anybody thereafter.
A date was set and We sent him a list of questions. Then a message from Otto..he had been hospitalised and had received death threats. But he would keep his appointment - we set up pour cameras in a venue in POTCHESYROOM and waited.
LINK The last message we received from Ben reads, sharpies, please ensure our safety, keep parties ,aside, looking forward to meeting you and your team. Smiley face. And we wait.
He didn't arrive. We again offered him a right of reply but his response was: my legal advise – you can do what you want to – we reserve all my rights.
Although Kallie is furious, he's taking the loss on his chin.
Kallie: We also made mistakes by investing in something we did not research. We should have made investigations into the business before just accepting that you ca get 2.5 per cent per month on an investment.
Danie still cant get over the fact that a day after he received notification from Otto that he was liquidating, he received a call from him asking for another R200 000 investment to try and keep part of RSA Search up and running.
Masa: what did you think????
Danie: He is insane...he is insane. He's mad. I couldnt believe it. I said to my wife, imagine. this guy has just done me in for a million and now he is asking for another R200 000.
INVESTORS HAVE LAID FRAUD CHARGES AGAINST OTTO but that will be cold comfort FOR those whose whose lives now have been severally impacted.
Mrs Meyer: It is going bad for me. I cant sleep. I was so anxious that I had to go to the doctor. I mean how do you sleep at night? Its a very tragic story story and he has devastated so many peoples lives.

UPSOUND: Otto: 3 per cent Presenter: 3 percent oper month on your money, Otto: that's right! That's 30 000 per month on a million rand investment. LINK: Otto had an interesting modus operandi. After a contract was signed he would accompany some investors to their banks to make sure the money was paid immediately 73 year old Mrs Meyer is also a window who lives in an old age home. After hearing about these 3 per cent returns she also met with Otto. Mrs Meyer: he talk and talk, and I listen...and I told him that I wanted to put in R300 000. She said that otto then drove her to her bank where he saw the balance of her account. Mrs Meyer: He sat there, his eyes roaming he saw how much I had, and he said how about another million. I said no. But he was persistent she said. Mrs Meyer: So he talked me and so I` said ok , another R900 000 Masa: So he would not let it rest because he saw how much you had? Mrs Meyer: : ya, ya, Hester and Mrs Meyer started received their handsome returns every month. It seems to have been a wise decision. LINK: Or had it been? Perhaps if these investors had been aware that Otto had ALLEGEDLY left investors high and dry in an other business he previously ran, they would have reconsidered putting their trust in him. LINK : OR HAD IT BEEN? IT’S BEEN. ALLEGED THAT OTTO LEFT MANY INVESTORS HIGH AND DRY IN ANOTHER BUSINESS HE RAN. Otto apparently developed a system which would allow financial transactions to take place between cell phones and he was going to list the company on the stock market. According to this investor who did not want to be identified, she lost over a million rand. Anon: we all bought shares because we were told that the company would be listing on the stock market or an overseas market: It did not happen she says, and she lost her money -another investor said he lost several million Anon: I can tell you, more than three million, that is what I put in, what ever was promised was never fulfilled.. from the other side – which is Ben Ottio. LINK ABOUT 157 INVESTORS BEOIEVED IN BENN OTTO'S RSA SALES PITCH- HE AOPPEARS TO HAVE RAKED IN ABOUT 44 MILLION RAND OF INVESTMENTS – BUT TROUBLE WAS LOOMING. Businessman Kallie Fourie was so impressed with otto when he met him in 2015 that he invested a million rand with him at 2.5 per cent returns. KALLIE: We were impressed by the man. The way he presented his company.. MASA: So a really nice person? KALLIE: Brilliant, brilliant, gift of the the gab, brilliant person. He then became alarmed because he said he saw company's budget for the 2019 financial year: just over 6 million rand investor profit sharing payments are listed under operational expenses. It seems he was paying these returns mostly from investments which he listed as income. KALLIE: If I hand this to a first year accounting student, they will be able to see that there is something wrong here. Then late payments of returns started occurring in 2020. Masa: so when did you start getting suspicious that something is fishy here? Danie: Actually on my second payment I thought why, if I invested on the 20th, by the 20th I expect my return, but it did not happen. In February Danie Rossouw had invested a million rand with Otto after being assured that his money would be safe. Danie: a million rand is a lot of money to invest... and he made some calculations there, and he said that he is 70 million strong, and I don't have to have any fears, everything is fine. Another widow, Ria Hannekom met with Otto in March this year and was ALSO assured by him that her investment would be safe. REA: when he came to my house, I told him that my husband had passed, and I told him what my plans were with money that my husband left. She invested 1.4 million rand but there were no returns for her...instead she and the another investors receive notifications via whats app and email from Otto – he was voluntarily liquidating RSA Search – blaming Covid 19. Rea is devastated because she WILL HAVE TO SELL HER HOME NOW REA: I try to be strong, but at night when you lock up the house and you are alone and you have to work things out by yourself. But you get the strength, tomorrow you stand up and you go on. The news stunned Mrs Meyer. Ms Meyer: My son phone the attorney and he said that he's been liquidated. There is no money. Can you imagine the shock, working all his life and saving – what would my husband would say to me? Kallie does not buy the Covid 19 explanation! Kallie: With the outbreak of covid 19, there were no more new investors, to pay the old investors, and for that reason he had to liquidate and run away from his responsibilities. After we alerted the FSCA about Otto's business model they then issued a media statement warning the public not to do business with him or RSA Search. It said that in terms of the FIAS act he was not entitled to take in deposits from the public. The liquidators, confirmed that RSA Search was insolvent and was liquidated on the 9th June. Our first attempt to invite Otto onto Carte Blanche failed. OTTO: Alright, I am going to end this conversation, now, do what you have to! Then we got a surprising call. He would speak to us after all. OTTO: So this will be my first appearance or talk to anybody and I am not going to talk to anybody thereafter. A date was set and We sent him a list of questions. Then a message from Otto..he had been hospitalised and had received death threats. But he would keep his appointment - we set up pour cameras in a venue in POTCHESYROOM and waited. LINK The last message we received from Ben reads, sharpies, please ensure our safety, keep parties ,aside, looking forward to meeting you and your team. Smiley face. And we wait. He didn't arrive. We again offered him a right of reply but his response was: my legal advise – you can do what you want to – we reserve all my rights. Although Kallie is furious, he's taking the loss on his chin. Kallie: We also made mistakes by investing in something we did not research. We should have made investigations into the business before just accepting that you ca get 2.5 per cent per month on an investment. Danie still cant get over the fact that a day after he received notification from Otto that he was liquidating, he received a call from him asking for another R200 000 investment to try and keep part of RSA Search up and running. Masa: what did you think???? Danie: He is insane...he is insane. He's mad. I couldnt believe it. I said to my wife, imagine. this guy has just done me in for a million and now he is asking for another R200 000. INVESTORS HAVE LAID FRAUD CHARGES AGAINST OTTO but that will be cold comfort FOR those whose whose lives now have been severally impacted. Mrs Meyer: It is going bad for me. I cant sleep. I was so anxious that I had to go to the doctor. I mean how do you sleep at night? Its a very tragic story story and he has devastated so many peoples lives.

metadata.Unique Selling Point: A Potchestroom businessman Ben Otto ran an online directory called RSA Search - an advertising booking platform for accommodation businesses in South Africa. He invited investors to invest into profit sharing of his company. He employed about 15 people. He took in over 40 million rand over the last three years and he paid high dividends . 3 per cent a month, and that is huge. The contract allowed for investors to withdraw their investments after 2 years. But, what he did was use new investments to pay these dividends and when people started to want their money back, he went into voluntarily liquidation during lock down - blaming covid 19. But here is the rub - his little business with so many employees was only taking in about R75 000 a month. Everybody has lost their investments, over 100charges have been laid against him, and following a report on this man I sent to the FSCA, they issued a public warning in the media against Otto and RSA Search.
metadata.Summary: His modus operandi - a huge ad spend on Kyknet, and radio stations. Utterly convincing and charming. But his desperation for money is evidenced by the fact that he actually accompanied older ladies to the bank to supervise them transferring their funds into his RSA account. And yes, investors did get high returns. Inevitably it all collapsed. Here is the gall of the man: he would approach investors who now have just lost their investments and ask them them for more money for another scheme. He has a history as well - over a decade ago he sold and issued share certificates but did not list them. many people lost millions.
metadata.Further information: A forensic psychiatrist describes these type of alleged conman as: convincing, charming, without remorse.I have already invited him for an interview and he said - do what I have to. One investor who Otto has approached for more money has set him up for a meeting tomorrow at 10am in Potechestroom. We can door stop him? BEN OTTO TREATMENT It's like a fortress...behind these walls lives a Potchestroom business man who has incurred the wrath of local investors ...but when potential investor Kallie Strydom met Ben Otto of RSA Search last year he only had high praise for him: Kallie: my heavens, you could not meet a nicer person..... And that was the impression he made on his many paid for advertorial interviews on Kyk Net's Die Groote Onbyt. UPSOUND - TV footage It was on this platform and on radio stations that Otto would offer investments and franchise opportunities into RSA Search - he called it “participating in the income of his online business and accommodation booking platform UPSOUND Kallie: He had a staff of about 15 people, and he was selling online ads for small businesses and accommodation – basically a search engine, clients would pay a monthly fee. Hester first saw Otto on TV in 2017 and she felt that he was the answer to her dreams,. Recently her husband had died and his pension was too little for her to survive,. She called Otto for a meeting. Hester: What a wonderful man, he spoke of the lord all the time, and he offered me 3 per cent returns on R680 000… that is all I had -. which would equate to R20 000 per month. LINK 1 Now Otto had an interesting modus operandi .... though some may call it desperate - he would actually accompany investors, like Hester to their banks to supervise their funds being transferred into his account. Presenter: Did that not surprise you? Hester: Answers Presenter to Sharleen: Did that not worry you that he wanted you to go to the bank straight away? Sharleen: Answers Sharleen also saw otto on TV . She was also a widow. The large returns for her investment of R800 00 0 seemed also an answer to prayers. Sharleen: xxxxx And both Sharleen and Hester each month received their handsome monthly returns,. It had been wise investment! LINK Or had it been? Perhaps if Hester and Sharleen had been aware that Otto had left investors high and dry in another business he ran ten years ago, they would have reconsidered putting their trust in him. In 2003 Otto developed a concept called IC Pay – it was using cell phones to pay accounts. He told investors that he was listing the company on the stock market - he sold share certificates for R1 each, which could be sold almost immediately for R8 on listing, XXXXX bought R1 million rands worth of shares XXX: it seemed so legitimate – a great idea. Presenter: What happened? XXXX: he suddenly put the company into liquidation. 100's of people lost everything – I know of one person who committed suicide. LINK An omen?... Otto started RSA Search in 2017, and a total of xxx investors were being paid their monthly returns but the first signs of trouble came in late 2018....The contract says that an investor could withdraw their investment after 2 years. Willem , who had invested R3 million tried tried to get his investment back: Willem : he said he did not have the cash available. And when Kallie ( from the beginning of the program) who invested 1.2 million demanded to see the books, he was horrified, Kallie: I asked him how profitable was RSA Search.- he admitted that there were months that he was only getting in R75 000 a month. 15 people working for him, and he is only getting in R75 000 a month. I was horrified. Kallie worked out that in order to pay investor returns, his business would have to be making over 2 million rand a month. Kallie: Then I saw his business spread sheet. He lists investors as as INCOME!! (We show 12 million rand investors money on the spread sheet – as INCOME.) LINK Hmmmmm, Paying investors's returns from new investments – now that sounds all to familiar doesn't it? – a tell tale sign on a ponzi sheme? Forensic Auditor:……xxxxxxxxx……, 3 per cent a month is unheard of. …....xxxxxxxxxxxxxx inevitably investments dry up. LINK Well, in March this year, investors all received a whats app message from Otto saying that he is putting RSA Search into voluntarily liquidation – and he blamed covid 19 for this!!! No apology! Hester: was devastated Sharleen: Was devastated. Equally devastated was Ria who a month before he liquidated had invested R1.4 million. Hester: He must have known that his business was in trouble – how could he take my money like that? Kallie: Covid 19 has nothing to do with it. His business was a non start from the beginning, his income was derived from investors! Carte Blanche sent a copy of RSA's contract to the FSCA and three weeks later they issued a media statement advising the public not to do business with Ben Otto and said that he was conducting unauthorised financial services and breaching various financial sector laws. 163 investors have laid charges against Ben otto and the hawks are investigating. LINK But there's more! Straight after liquidating his company, Otto began contacting investors who now had just lost everything ....... asking them if they wanted to invest in a new scheme of his! Danie, who is battling cancer, in January had invested R1 mill into RSA Search . He has come to terms that he has lost that money but he was astonished when he got a call from otto: Danie: he wanted me to invest in............... Presenter: Seriously? Danie: xxxxx Presenter: Did he apologise to you about your lost investment? Danie: it was if nothing had happened! Presenter: What did you say? Danie: I strung him along. We had tried to get an on camera interview with Otto but we were fobbed off. Unsound: Do what you have to! So We tagged along with Danie who set up a meeting with Otto to discuss another investment – confrontation.
